fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_19[0]
fields.speak: 3. Open parenthesis. Qualified business net (loss) carryforward from the prior year. Close parenthesis.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_20[0]
fields.speak: 4. Total qualified business income. Combine lines 2 and 3. If zero or less, enter 0.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_21[0]

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].Line6_ReadOrder[0].f1_22[0]
fields.speak: 6. Qualified R E I T dividends and publicly traded partnership (P T P) income or (loss) (see instructions).

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_23[0]
fields.speak: 7. Open parenthesis. Qualified R E I T dividends and qualified P T P (loss) carryforward from the prior year. Close parenthesis.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_24[0]
fields.speak: 8. Total qualified R E I T dividends and P T P income. Combine lines 6 and 7. If zero or less, enter 0.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_25[0]
fields.speak: 9. R E I T and P T P component. Multiply line 8 by 20% (0.20).

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_26[0]
fields.speak: 10. Qualified business income deduction before the income limitation. Add lines 5 and 9.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_27[0]
fields.speak: 11. Taxable income before qualified business income deduction (see instructions).

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_28[0]
fields.speak: 12. Enter your net capital gain, if any, increased by any qualified dividends (see instructions).

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_29[0]
fields.speak: 13. Subtract line 12 from line 11. If zero or less, enter 0.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_30[0]
fields.speak: 14. Income limitation. Multiply line 13 by 20% (0.20).

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_31[0]
fields.speak: 15. Qualified business income deduction. Enter the smaller of line 10 or line 14. Also enter this amount on the applicable line of your return (see instructions).

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_32[0]
fields.speak: 16. Open parenthesis. Total qualified business (loss) carryforward. Combine lines 2 and 3. If greater than zero, enter 0. Close parenthesis.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_33[0]
fields.speak: 17. Open parenthesis.  Total qualified R E I T dividends and P T P (loss) carryforward. Combine lines 6 and 7. If greater than zero, enter 0. Close parenthesis.
